final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT CustomerId, SUM(Total) as CustomerTotal FROM Invoice GROUP BY CustomerId), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(CustomerTotal) as GrandTotal FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.CustomerId, step1.CustomerTotal, CAST(step1.CustomerTotal AS REAL) / step2.GrandTotal as Ratio FROM step1, step2 WHERE step2.GrandTotal IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(Ratio) as AvgRatio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.CustomerId, step3.CustomerTotal, step3.Ratio, (step3.Ratio - step4.AvgRatio) / step4.AvgRatio as PctDiff FROM step3, step4 WHERE step4.AvgRatio IS NOT NULL AND step3.Ratio > step4.AvgRatio) SELECT AVG(CustomerTotal) as AvgCustomerTotal, AVG(Ratio) as AvgRatio, AVG(PctDiff) as AvgPctDiff FROM step5
